subject: English 1st Paper
topic: Lesson-31: Too Much or Too Little Water

source.edition: Revised for the year 2026; revised edition October 2025

passagePolicy: Use the specifically cited source section in the NCTB textbook. Full textbook passages and images are not reproduced. Original writing models are not source facts.

activities.instruction: Answer using the cited text. Equivalent accurate wording is acceptable; support interpretations with details.

items.question: How can heavy rainfall cause flooding in the passage?
items.modelAnswer: River water can overflow its banks and cover large areas of land.

items.question: What places can be flooded according to Section A2?
items.modelAnswer: Land, towns and villages can be flooded.

items.question: How can a long period without rain affect water availability?
items.modelAnswer: Rivers may dry up and underground water levels may fall, creating shortages.

items.question: Give one possible difficulty caused by too little water.
items.modelAnswer: People may have difficulty finding enough safe water for drinking and daily needs. This is a supported application of the lesson’s discussion.

items.question: What contrast does the lesson title express?
items.modelAnswer: Both excess water in floods and a shortage of water can cause suffering.
